headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs driven by record FII buying and banking recovery.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Record FII buying supported a four-week rally lifting benchmark indices to multi-month highs.
Recovery in banking and IT stocks helped offset earlier intraday losses.
Concerns over potential US Fed rate hikes and global AI tech sell-offs weighed on market sentiment.
BSE Sensex index rejig announced ahead of December rebalancing.
whatHappening: APL Apollo agreed to acquire Tata Steel's tubes and colors business for Rs 28,000 crore.
Shriram Finance will join the BSE Sensex index on December 21, taking the place of Trent.
Lodha Developers announced Chairman Mukund Chitale's resignation, with Akhil Gupta replacing him.
FSSAI reported a sample of Bisleri packaged drinking water as unsafe.
summary: Indian benchmark indices reached 9-month highs supported by record FII inflows and gains in banking and IT stocks. Major corporate developments include APL Apollo acquiring Tata Steel's tubes and colors unit for Rs 28,000 crore. Additionally, Shriram Finance is set to replace Trent in the BSE Sensex effective December 21.
